formula: V_post = 1/(1/V_prior + 1/V_new); mu_post = V_post*(mu_prior/V_prior + mu_new/V_new); SD_post = sqrt(V_post)
packages: base R; stats::qnorm; sf; terra; ggplot2
assumptions: Prior mean = 12 + 2*(scaled east coordinate - 0.5) kg C/m2, independent of workbook inputs. Prior SD = 5; new estimate = four-core IDW; assumed new-estimate SD = 3. Errors treated as independent Gaussian cell-level errors. SDs are assumptions, not between-core SDs or fitted standard errors. Shared spatial errors and model bias are omitted. Conditional intervals do not validate real stocks; no AOI total uncertainty is calculated. Normal support may include negative stock in other examples.
